text: APPROVE: the three extracted helpers (`WorkspaceDirsByName`, `TransitiveWorkspaceDeps`, `ReportChangeFilters` with `ChangeFilterSite`) move the code over unchanged, including the `reported.Add` dedupe and the message text. That removes the nested loops and conditionals that made up most of the 29 points, which should bring `ChangeFilters` under 15. I could not see the rest of the file, so the build is unconfirmed: the new signatures assume `runs` is a `HashSet<TestInvocation>`, `missed` is a `List<string>`, and that `CiChangeFilter` and `JsInventory.Inventory` are the real type names.
